mainEntity.name: Is AEO more important for residential or commercial roofing services?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO is beneficial for both residential and commercial roofing services, though the specific questions and keywords will differ. Residential customers often search for immediate problem-solving ('leaky roof repair cost') or home improvement questions ('best shingles for my home'). Commercial clients might inquire about maintenance contracts, specific material certifications, or large-scale project management capabilities ('commercial flat roof installation'). Implementing AEO ensures both segments find relevant, direct answers from your business, enhancing your authority and lead generation across your entire service offering.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO is important for both residential and commercial roofing, though the specific questions and target keywords will differ. It helps both segments find direct answers from your business.
